headline: Travelsoft says its Orchestra booking platform was hit by a cyberattack; French travel sites went offline Nov 20.
summary: First draft. 2 sources (2 Tier 2), 9 claims, 5 questions. The company's president tells two outlets with different owners that Orchestra was hit by a cyberattack. Stolen logins are Reported (TourMaG, unnamed sources). Data theft is Not established. No Travelsoft notice or CNIL statement found. Privacy check done: no names of people, no handles, no contact details.
